title: Tighten the new-untracked-only gate wording and the summary renderer after item C's round 5 (W9, Lows)
outcome: Tighten the new-untracked-only gate wording and the summary renderer after item C's round 5 (W9, Lows)
acceptance: The test launcher selects and renders the `new-untracked-only` reason only when newUntrackedOnly(result) holds, so a malformed saved results.json with that reason but no valid inputCheck cannot make the summary throw; a regression test covers it.

review-changes.md section 2, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md carry W9a–c, or a later concurred equivalent: the untracked listing may show exactly the run's recorded new paths and nothing else; a new-untracked-only full gate is recorded once, as a pass, only by the integration owner after its disposition note, with --ref naming the run, and the parent records nothing for it before then. Landed through the authority-text process: (a) both coordinators concur, (b) the wording is sent to Greg, (c) the final-diff audit is recorded.
